Courts consistently rule against such practices as unconstitutional and discriminatory. - Employees who act on racial bias could lose their jobs or face criminal charges (e.g., for false imprisonment or harassment). 3. **Ineffective & Harmful**: - Crime is not tied to race—criminals come from all backgrounds. This approach is fair, legal, and effective. Racial profiling has no place in ethical business practices.
